title: Rectangle Member Function
prompt: Given the Rectangle struct below, implement the member function `scaled(factor)` returning a NEW Rectangle scaled on both sides (original untouched).

tests.name: scales
tests.code: Rectangle r{.width = 2.0, .height = 3.0}; Rectangle s = r.scaled(2.0); CHECK_NEAR(s.width, 4.0, 0.001); CHECK_NEAR(s.height, 6.0, 0.001);
tests.hint: Both members multiply by the factor.

tests.name: original intact
tests.code: Rectangle r{.width = 2.0, .height = 3.0}; Rectangle s = r.scaled(2.0); CHECK_NEAR(r.width, 2.0, 0.001);
tests.hint: The function is const — the original stays put.
